places.name: Arctic Cathedral
places.ai_summary: A modern architectural masterpiece and iconic landmark of Tromsø, known for its striking design and stained glass windows.

opening_hours.notes: Opening hours may vary during events.

places.place_tip: Attend a midnight sun or northern lights concert.

places.name: Polaria
places.ai_summary: An Arctic experience center featuring an aquarium, educational exhibits, and a panoramic cinema showcasing the northern lights.

opening_hours.notes: Open year-round.

places.place_tip: Don't miss the bearded seal feeding session.

places.name: Fjellheisen
places.ai_summary: A cable car that takes you up to Mount Storsteinen, offering panoramic views of Tromsø, the surrounding islands, and the fjords.

opening_hours.notes: Closed for maintenance from mid-April to mid-May.

places.place_tip: Hike the trail to the top for a more rewarding experience.

places.name: Polar Museum
places.ai_summary: A museum dedicated to Arctic hunting history, featuring exhibits on seal hunting, polar expeditions, and the indigenous Sami people.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on May 17th (Norwegian Constitution Day).

places.place_tip: Combine with a visit to the Arctic Cathedral.

places.name: Tromsø Bridge
places.ai_summary: A cantilever road bridge that connects Tromsøya island to the mainland, offering stunning views of the city and the surrounding fjords.

opening_hours.notes: Best viewed during the midnight sun or northern lights seasons.

places.place_tip: Walk or cycle for an up-close experience.

places.name: Tromsø University Museum
places.ai_summary: The largest museum in Northern Norway, featuring exhibits on Sami culture, natural history, and the northern lights.

opening_hours.notes: Open year-round, but hours may vary in winter.

places.place_tip: Check out the planetarium shows.

places.name: Arctic-Alpine Botanic Garden
places.ai_summary: The world's northernmost botanic garden, showcasing Arctic and alpine plants in a stunning natural setting.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during the flowering season (June to August).

places.best_time_to_visit: Late evening for midnight sun views
places.place_tip: Bring a camera and a picnic.

places.name: Tromsø Cathedral
places.ai_summary: A beautiful wooden cathedral in Tromsø, known for its distinctive architecture and serene interior.

opening_hours.notes: Open for concerts and special events.

places.place_tip: Attend a concert for a unique experience.

places.name: Northern Lights Tours
places.ai_summary: Guided tours that take you to the best spots around Tromsø to experience the magical northern lights.

opening_hours.notes: Available from September to April.

places.best_time_to_visit: Evening, during the northern lights season
places.place_tip: Dress warmly and bring a camera.

places.name: Sami Culture Experience
places.ai_summary: Immerse yourself in the traditional Sami culture, including reindeer herding, Sami cuisine, and handicrafts.

opening_hours.notes: Advance booking is required.

places.place_tip: Try the traditional Sami dish, bidos (reindeer stew).

places.name: Dog Sledding Adventure
places.ai_summary: An exhilarating experience where you can drive your own dog sled team through the Arctic wilderness.

opening_hours.notes: Available from December to April.

places.best_time_to_visit: Morning, for the best snow conditions
places.place_tip: Wear warm clothing and sturdy boots.

places.name: Whale Watching Cruise
places.ai_summary: A boat tour that takes you out into the fjords to see whales in their natural habitat.

opening_hours.notes: Best time for whale watching is from November to January.

places.best_time_to_visit: Afternoon, for the best light conditions
places.place_tip: Bring warm clothing and a camera.

places.name: Midnight Sun Viewpoint
places.ai_summary: A popular viewpoint to experience the midnight sun, where the sun never sets below the horizon during summer.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited from late May to mid-July.

places.place_tip: Bring a blanket and enjoy a picnic.

places.name: Mack Brewery Tour
places.ai_summary: A tour of the world's northernmost brewery, where you can learn about the beer-making process and taste local brews.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on public holidays.

places.place_tip: Try the Arctic Beer and the beer tasting platter.

places.name: Prestvannet Lake Walk
places.ai_summary: A scenic walk around a picturesque lake located on Tromsøya island, popular for birdwatching and enjoying the midnight sun.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited from late May to mid-July.

places.place_tip: Bring binoculars for birdwatching.

places.name: Tromsø Wilderness Centre
places.ai_summary: A center offering a range of outdoor activities and experiences in the Arctic wilderness, including hiking, fishing, and wildlife safaris.

opening_hours.notes: Advance booking is recommended.

places.place_tip: Inquire about seasonal activities.

places.name: Tromsø Ice Domes
places.ai_summary: A unique hotel and attraction made entirely of ice and snow, featuring ice sculptures, an ice bar, and snow hotel rooms.

opening_hours.notes: Open from December to April.

places.place_tip: Book a guided tour for the best experience.

places.name: Telegrafbukta Beach
places.ai_summary: A scenic beach located a short drive from Tromsø, popular for swimming, sunbathing, and picnicking.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during the summer months.

places.place_tip: Bring a picnic and enjoy the view.

places.name: Reindeer Feeding Experience
places.ai_summary: An interactive experience where you can feed and learn about reindeer, a significant part of Sami culture.

opening_hours.notes: Available from November to April.

places.place_tip: Combine with a visit to a Sami camp.

places.name: Aurora Sky Station
places.ai_summary: A viewing platform located in the mountains, offering a spectacular vantage point for observing the northern lights.

opening_hours.notes: Access by guided tour only, from September to April.

places.best_time_to_visit: Evening, during the northern lights season
places.place_tip: Dress warmly and bring a camera.
